plugins.name: learning-framework
plugins.description: Adult learning & knowledge management meta-router — 12 cognitive science-based frameworks (Zettelkasten, Second Brain/PARA, Evergreen Notes, Spaced Repetition, Active Recall, Feynman Technique, Interleaving, Deliberate Practice, Chunking, Deep Work, Pomodoro, Metalearning). Based on Ebbinghaus, Roediger, Karpicke, Bjork, Ericsson research. Korean learner context (SAT, civil service, CPA, 회독). Invoke /learn.

skills.name: active-recall
skills.description: Active Recall (Retrieval Practice) — The testing effect by Roediger·Karpicke. Retrieval (re-test) beats re-study for long-term memory. Pitfalls of highlighting·rereading, the generation effect, desirable difficulty.
headings: Relationship Between Korean Learning Culture and Active Recall
skills.description_zh: 运用主动回忆与提取练习设计复测，说明重读划线陷阱、生成效应及适度困难，以支持长期记忆。

skills.name: chunking
skills.description: Chunking — Miller's 7±2 short-term memory constraint, expert chunk perception, and chunk-size calibration in learning design. Meaningless individual items → meaningful chunks = expanded processing capacity. The core representational unit of expertise.
headings: What to Use Alongside This Framework
skills.description_zh: 依据原说明的Miller短期记忆约束和专家分块认知，将单独信息组织为有意义组块，并校准学习设计的组块大小。

skills.name: deep-work
skills.description: Deep Work — Cal Newport. Distinguishing shallow work from deep work, attention as a muscle, and the four disciplines (monastic/bimodal/rhythmic/journalistic). A framework for designing focused time blocks for knowledge workers.
headings: Friction with Korean Organizational and Learning Culture
What to Use Alongside This Framework
skills.description_zh: 运用Cal Newport深度工作框架区分浅层与深度任务，采用修道、双模、节奏或记者式安排，为知识工作者设计专注时间块。

skills.name: deliberate-practice
skills.description: Deliberate Practice — Anders Ericsson's theory of deliberate practice. Expertise is forged not by time but by *conditions*: specific goals, immediate feedback, just beyond current limits, intense focus. The '10,000-hour rule' is Gladwell-style hyperbole that Ericsson himself refuted.
headings: 4. Choose Tasks Just Beyond the Limit
7. Coach or Mentor (the feedback channel is the biggest bottleneck to progress)
Frameworks That Pair With This One
skills.description_zh: 运用Anders Ericsson刻意练习框架，设置具体目标、即时反馈、略超当前能力及高度专注条件，原说明区分此理论与一万小时口号。

skills.name: evergreen-notes
skills.description: Evergreen Notes — Andy Matuschak's digital note-taking practice. Concept-oriented, continuously edited, densely linked, atomic. A digital successor to Zettelkasten and more than research notes. Notes are not disposable but *something you come back to and revise*.
skills.description_zh: 运用Andy Matuschak常青笔记实践建立概念导向、原子化、密集链接和持续修订的数字笔记，支持反复回顾的知识积累。

skills.name: feynman-technique
skills.description: Feynman Technique — a method of revealing gaps in understanding by explaining to a beginner. 4-step protocol (Choose → Teach → Identify gaps → Simplify). ELI5 approach. The fastest tool to break the illusion of competence.
headings: Using AI as a Feedback Channel
What to Use Alongside This Framework
skills.description_zh: 通过选择主题、向初学者讲解、识别缺口和简化四步费曼方法，揭示理解不足并降低能力错觉。

skills.name: interleaving
skills.description: Interleaving — mixing multiple topics and problem types during study. Compared to blocked repetition, short-term performance ↓ but long-term retention and transfer ↑. Bjork's desirable difficulty. Effectiveness demonstrated in math problem types, sports skills, and language training.
headings: What to Use Alongside This Framework
skills.description_zh: 在学习中交错多个主题和题型，而非集中重复同类练习，依据原说明讨论短期表现与长期保留迁移的权衡。

skills.name: learn
skills.description: Adult learning & knowledge management meta-router — auto-selects from 12 cognitive-science / educational-psychology frameworks (Zettelkasten, Spaced Repetition, Active Recall, Deliberate Practice, Deep Work, etc.). Covers exam prep, certifications, new-field acquisition, knowledge accumulation, expertise growth, and focus retraining. Korean learner context (CSAT / civil service / certifications / 회독 / 오답노트) built-in.
headings: Dunlosky et al. (2013) learning technique efficacy ranking
A. Exam / certification passing (deadline, cutoff, evaluation with right answers)
B. Execution skill acquisition (code / instrument / foreign-language speaking / sports / cooking / presentation)
C. Knowledge accumulation / research / writing (lifelong, specialized)
D. Focus retraining (can't study at all)
Detection Matrix (2nd tier: concrete signal → framework)
Cross-domain reference (use existing repos as MOCs)
skills.description_zh: 作为成人学习与知识管理路由，从12个认知科学及教育心理框架选择方法，覆盖备考、认证、新领域、知识积累、专长与专注训练，并考虑韩国学习情境。

skills.name: metalearning
skills.description: Metalearning — Barbara Oakley *Learning How to Learn* + Scott Young *Ultralearning*. Focused/diffuse modes, illusion of competence, MOC (map of content), learning project design. The upper layer for rapidly acquiring new fields.
headings: How to Learn With AI (Feynman Audience-ification)
What to Combine This Framework With
skills.description_zh: 结合Barbara Oakley与Scott Young的元学习方法，理解专注扩散模式、能力错觉和内容地图，设计快速学习新领域的项目。

skills.name: pomodoro-and-focus
skills.description: Pomodoro Technique (Cirillo 25/5) + focus variants (50/10, 90-minute ultradian). Sophie Leroy's attention residue. Train attention muscle through short focus units + timeboxing tool. The implementation layer of Deep Work.
headings: What to Use This Framework With
skills.description_zh: 运用25/5番茄钟、50/10或90分钟专注变体与时间盒，考虑注意残留，通过短单元训练专注，支持深度工作实施。

skills.name: second-brain-para
skills.description: Building a Second Brain — Tiago Forte's personal knowledge management system. PARA (Projects/Areas/Resources/Archives) organization + CODE (Capture/Organize/Distill/Express) workflow. Strong on execution-orientation and project linkage. For when you're drowning in information or stuck on where to put what.
skills.description_zh: 运用Tiago Forte第二大脑的PARA组织与CODE流程，捕获整理提炼表达信息，并关联项目执行，适用于信息过载或归档困惑。

skills.name: spaced-repetition
skills.description: Spaced Repetition — interval-based review learning rooted in Ebbinghaus's forgetting curve. SM-2 and FSRS algorithms. Anki and SuperMemo lineage. The strongest tool for memorizing terminology, facts, language vocabulary, medicine, and law. Managing the long-term retention curve.
skills.description_zh: 依据遗忘曲线采用间隔复习，介绍SM-2、FSRS及Anki、SuperMemo方法，支持术语、事实、词汇、医学和法律知识长期记忆管理。

skills.name: zettelkasten
skills.description: Zettelkasten — Niklas Luhmann's atomic-note, link-based knowledge system. Distinguishes fleeting/literature/permanent notes, one note = one idea, connections matter more than content. For long-term knowledge accumulation, writing, and researchers.
headings: Frameworks That Pair Well With This One
skills.description_zh: 运用Niklas Luhmann卡片盒原子笔记和链接系统，区分临时、文献和永久笔记，按一条一想法组织，支持长期知识积累、写作及研究。
